name: resilient-api-fallback
description: Get exchange rates from a primary API with retries and a timeout; if it still fails, use a backup API; sanity-check the data before reporting it.

primary_url.description: Primary API (the base currency is appended). Set it to a broken URL to watch the fallback work.

fallback_url.description: Backup API (the base currency is appended)

max_age_days.description: Reject data older than this many days (markets close on weekends)

notify_channel.description: Optional OpenClaw channel for the report (telegram, slack, discord, feishu...)

notify_target.description: Optional chat id / channel id for notify_channel

steps.run: curl -fsSL --max-time 10 "$LOBSTER_ARG_PRIMARY_URL$LOBSTER_ARG_BASE" | node -e 'const text = require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8"); if (!text.trim()) { console.error("no response (network or HTTP error)"); process.exit(1) } let d; try { d = JSON.parse(text) } catch (e) { console.error("response is not JSON"); process.exit(1) } if (d.result !== "success") { console.error("primary API said: " + (d["error-type"] || d.result)); process.exit(1) } console.log(JSON.stringify({ source: "open.er-api.com", base: d.base_code, date: new Date(d.time_last_update_unix * 1000).toISOString().slice(0, 10), rates: d.rates }))'

curl -fsSL --max-time 10 "$LOBSTER_ARG_FALLBACK_URL$LOBSTER_ARG_BASE" | node -e 'const text = require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8"); if (!text.trim()) { console.error("no response (network or HTTP error)"); process.exit(1) } let d; try { d = JSON.parse(text) } catch (e) { console.error("response is not JSON"); process.exit(1) } console.log(JSON.stringify({ source: "frankfurter.dev", base: d.base, date: d.date, rates: d.rates }))'

node -e 'const parse = s => { try { return JSON.parse(s) } catch (e) { return null } }; const why = s => String(s || "").trim().split("\n").pop().replace(/^workflow command failed \(\d+\): /, ""); const p = parse(process.env.PRIMARY); const f = parse(process.env.FALLBACK); const data = p || f; if (!data) { console.error("Both APIs failed. Primary: " + why(process.env.PRIMARY_ERROR) + ". Backup: " + why(process.env.FALLBACK_ERROR)); process.exit(1) } console.log(JSON.stringify(Object.assign({}, data, { usedFallback: !p, primaryError: p ? null : why(process.env.PRIMARY_ERROR) })))'

node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")); const wanted = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_SYMBOLS.split(",").map(s => s.trim().toUpperCase()).filter(Boolean); const problems = []; const missing = wanted.filter(s => !(d.rates[s] > 0)); if (missing.length) problems.push("missing or invalid rates for " + missing.join(", ")); const age = Math.floor((Date.now() - Date.parse(d.date)) / 86400000); if (!(age <= Number(process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_MAX_AGE_DAYS))) problems.push("data is " + age + " days old"); if (d.base !== process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_BASE.toUpperCase()) problems.push("base is " + d.base); if (problems.length) { console.error(problems.join("; ")); process.exit(1) } console.log(JSON.stringify({ wanted, age }))'

node -e 'const why = process.env.WHY.trim().split("\n").pop().replace(/^workflow command failed \(\d+\): /, ""); console.log("⚠️ Exchange-rate data failed the sanity check, nothing was sent: " + why)'

node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(process.env.DATA); const wanted = JSON.parse(process.env.WANTED); const lines = ["💱 1 " + d.base + " = " + wanted.map(s => d.rates[s].toLocaleString("en-US", { maximumFractionDigits: 4 }) + " " + s).join(" · "), "Source: " + d.source + ", " + d.date + (d.usedFallback ? " (backup API used, primary failed: " + d.primaryError + ")" : "")]; console.log(lines.join("\n"))'

MSG=$(cat); if [ -n "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" ]; then openclaw message send --channel "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_CHANNEL" --target "$LOBSTER_ARG_NOTIFY_TARGET" --message "$MSG" >&2; fi; printf '%s\n' "$MSG"
